column1: # Hostnames a Samsung TV contacts, from our S90D's router log (Sept 2026: about 80 distinct hostnames in 5 hours;
# the ad, tracking, analytics and ACR ones are listed here, plus the ones the TV needs).
# Source for tools/blocklist.sh, which turns this file into lists for AdGuard, Pi-hole, hosts files and NextDNS.
# Columns (tab-separated): group  host  tested  what it is
#   group   ads, telemetry, acr      blocked by default
#           voice, smartthings, tvplus, hdmi-id, apps   optional: each one turns a feature off
#           keep                     never block: the TV breaks without it (written out as an allowlist)
#   tested  yes    blocked on our TV, and the app store, account and streaming apps kept working
#           seen   our TV contacted it, not yet tested blocked on its own
#           known  documented by others (ACR endpoints: our TV never contacted them with Viewing Information Services off)
#   For keep rows, yes means our TV uses it all the time; "breaks without it" comes from our tests and others' reports.
# Untested in the default groups: img-resize-cdn-prod.samsungnyc.com and lcprd1.samsungcloudsolution.net (tested=seen).
# One TV (an EU S90D). Your TV may use other hosts: watch your own DNS log (docs/11-no-root.md).
